title: Finite hypergraph rounding and the asymptotic triangle-packing gap
abstract: Formalizes a finite ceiling-carrying nibble theorem for uniform hypergraphs that are near-regular outside a small exceptional set and have suitably bounded codegrees, and derives the uniform subquadratic gap between fractional and integral triangle packing in finite graphs, together with its fractional-cover formulation.

informal.LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.nearR: For every uniformity and positive error tolerance, sufficiently large finite uniform hypergraphs with bounded codegrees, near-regular degrees outside a small exceptional set, and a global degree ceiling admit a matching covering the prescribed fraction of their vertices.
informal.LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.trian: For every positive error tolerance, all sufficiently large finite graphs have fractional triangle-packing optimum at most their integral triangle-packing optimum plus the error tolerance times the square of the number of vertices.

For every positive error tolerance, all sufficiently large finite graphs have fractional triangle-cover optimum at most their integral triangle-packing optimum plus the error tolerance times the square of the number of vertices.
